notes.title: 🎬 Shattered Dimensions New Trailer is Live! 🔥
notes.content:
Hello friends! The time has finally come to share! 🎉[p align="start"]We're thrilled to share the brand new trailer for Shattered Dimensions with you. You can see the first real footage from the game we've been working on for months.
📺 Watch the Trailer:[previewyoutube="KUfoMKfRkNo;full"][/previewyoutube]
If you like it, please don't forget to add to your Wishlist! As a small studio, your support means everything to us. ❤️

Share your thoughts about the trailer in the comments, ask us anything you're curious about!

See you soon! Domestic Goose Studio 🪿
